title: A woman in a man's world
summary: Being among men taught her their thinking; Monk said she was the only woman he'd listen to.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Life philosophy: faith, karma and how to live

blocks.x: You mentioned being around men all the time. You spent your whole life really in a man's world.

On his lap and in his world, yet I'm feminine. You know, some women they change their sex after they've been around men like that all the time, but being around men gave me, you know, like Monk said once when he was here at the house and Nelly, his wife was talking to him. He says, "I won't listen to silly women. Mary's the only woman I'll take any advice from." See, they taught me their trend of thought and their way of thinking. I'd rather gossip in front of a man because it really isn't gossip. You're talking to have fun, you know, it's something to laugh about. But if I did that with a woman

it would be all over the country and it would be gossip, they just sound different. Now I feel I'm out of place... I know some very good women musicians but I'm just out of place with them. If I had to do a battle or anything with them I wouldn't play nothing because I do have something like this happen, that they're not my equal, and that's very bad. That could be prejudice or something's the matter. I never want to be prejudiced or something like that, but there's something else, John, something like they're still thinking this way and I don't think that way. I withdraw. If I had a contest or had to do something with another woman, she'd win; I'd give it to her because she doesn't matter to me that much. I never thought about breaking that because it isn't important. I don't harm anybody through it.
